technology_name: AN ENGINEERED GEOPOLYMER COMPOSITE (EGC) INTEGRATED WITH COLD-FORMED STEEL FOR SUSTAINABLE CONSTRUCTION APPLICATIONS
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Traditional reinforced concrete flexural members require heavy, expensive hot-rolled steel rebar assemblies that take extended field labor durations and exhibit low corrosion lifespans.
description: An innovative high-performance flexural system integrating a sustainable, industrial waste-derived cementless Engineered Geopolymer Composite (EGC) shell with a prefabricated structural cage mechanism forged entirely out of cold-formed steel ($CFS$).
applications: Prefabricated modular building modules, low-cost sustainable housing panels, high-durability highway retaining walls, and lightweight civil infrastructure decking.
secondary_sector: Energy, Climate & Sustainability, Water, Environment & Waste Management, Infrastructure, Construction & Smart Cities
